name: Taste of Blood
body:
The taste of blood bolsters your vicious bite attack on the following round.

Prerequisite: Anumus, Vicious Bite feat, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: When you score a hit with your vicious bite, you gain a +2 racial bonus to your attack roll for vicious bite during the next round.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
